lines.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
I was glad when they said to me,
“Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
Our feet are standing in your gates,
O Jerusalem.
Jerusalem is built up
as a city united together,
where the tribes go up,
the tribes of the LORD,
as a testimony for Israel,
to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
For there the thrones of judgment stand,
the thrones of the house of David.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem:
“May those who love you prosper.
May there be peace within your walls,
and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
For the sake of my brothers and friends,
I will say, “Peace be within you.”
For the sake of the house of the LORD our God,
I will seek your prosperity.

pictures.scene: William Holman Hunt, The Finding of the Saviour in the Temple - the boy Jesus in the blue striped robe with the red sash standing in the temple, his mother in grey leaning her head down to his and her hands on his shoulders, Joseph in the red turban behind them and the old rabbis seated with their scrolls, the golden temple door standing open at the right, a song of ascents of David, I was glad when they said to me let us go to the house of the LORD, our feet are standing in your gates O Jerusalem
pictures.name: pd_hunt_huis

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Census at Bethlehem - the whole village crowded up to the window of the inn where the registration is being taken, the clerk at his table with the book and the people pressing in around him, the church tower standing over the snowy roofs behind and the carts and the barrels drawn up in the street, Jerusalem is built up as a city united together, where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD, for there the thrones of judgment stand
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_volkstelling

pictures.scene: Ambrogio Lorenzetti, The Effects of Good Government in the City - the women dancing hand in hand in the open street with the tambourine, the shops standing open along the way and the rider going quietly through the gate, the rose and grey towers and the battlemented walls rising above the whole town, the thrones of the house of David, pray for the peace of Jerusalem, may those who love you prosper, may there be peace within your walls and prosperity inside your fortresses, for the sake of my brothers and friends
pictures.name: pd_lorenzetti_muren

pictures.scene: Christen Dalsgaard, A Woman's Solemn Churching after Childbirth - the old pastor standing in the lit archway of the church with his book held to his breast and his hand opened out in welcome, the gilded altar glowing behind him, the mother seated in the shadow at the left with the child in her arms and the blue door standing open between them, I will say peace be within you, for the sake of the house of the LORD our God I will seek your prosperity
pictures.name: pd_dalsgaard_kerkgang
